observations: Used automotive gearbox lying on concrete floor
Dirty oily metal casing with mounting flanges and bolts
Input shaft visible at bottom with splines
Electrical connector or sensor attached to side
Paper labels and stickers present but text unreadable
Two angles show opposite sides of the same unit
Watermark 'KENELIX AUTOTECH LIMITED' across both photos
Person's foot in slide sandal visible for scale

claims.claim: This gear box is like no other
claims.evidence: Seller's subjective statement; no photo can prove uniqueness

risks.proof: Video of the unit rotated by hand and shifted through all gears on a bench

risks.risk: Internal parts may be missing or the unit may be incomplete
risks.proof: Photo of the open casing or full rotation showing all shift rails

risks.risk: Part number or fitment cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of any casting number, label, or tag

risks.risk: Seals may leak or output shaft may be damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of shaft seals and drain/fill plugs

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any part number or casting number on the casing
Video of the gearbox rotated by hand and shifted through all gears
Close-up of input and output shafts and seal areas
response.reason: The item is visibly a used car gearbox, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working; internal condition cannot be verified from exterior photos alone.
